wave: SELF-DECLARATION CORRECTNESS -- WebUI materialization declared the wrong path, blocking coding_admission for this whole session
wave_title: `.atlas/declared/system.adl` declared `materialize WebUI { path = "apps/ui" }`, but `apps/ui/` has never existed in this repository -- the real, existing frontend scaffold is `apps/studio` (README.md, package.json, design/tokens.json), which is also what `.atlas/repo.toml`'s own `frontend_roots`/`test_roots` correctly reference. The ADL declaration and the manifest disagreed about where the frontend lives; the ADL declaration was simply wrong (a stale path, not a genuinely missing implementation). This was the sole real, currently-blocking coding_admission.allowed:false condition throughout every generation this session (surfaced correctly starting with the commit that fixed constraint_results gating, 0f4735e0be), and it is now corrected.

priority_classification: correctness/architectural integrity (priority 1) -- two canonical truth sources (`.atlas/repo.toml` and `.atlas/declared/system.adl`) disagreed about a basic fact (where the frontend lives), and the wrong one was the ADL declaration Atlas's own materialization-verification machinery checks against.

design_decisions.question: Fix the declared path, or create an `apps/ui` directory (e.g. a symlink or stub) to match the existing (wrong) declaration?
design_decisions.decision: Fix the declared path. `apps/studio` is the real, manifest-referenced, already-scaffolded frontend location (README.md, package.json, design/tokens.json already present); `apps/ui` has no basis anywhere else in the repository. Creating a stub `apps/ui` to satisfy a stale declaration would be exactly the kind of 'materialize just to make a metric look better' the standing loop's extinction-discipline principle warns against in spirit -- the correct fix is to make the declaration honest, not to fabricate matching filesystem state.

design_decisions.question: Also add `language = typescript` to the materialize block, matching the WebUI entity's own `language = typescript` attribute and the pattern used by Core/Adapter/Runtime's materialize blocks (which each redundantly declare `language = rust`)?
design_decisions.decision: No, not yet. `apps/studio` currently contains only README.md/package.json/design/tokens.json -- no `.ts`/`.tsx` files. Declaring `language = typescript` on the materialize block would immediately trigger the sibling `MATERIALIZATION_LANGUAGE_NOT_OBSERVED` check (`ATLAS-E054`, fixed earlier this session) and re-introduce a coding_admission blocker -- correctly this time, since no TypeScript source is observed there yet. Per this project's own 'never claim a fact this extractor cannot prove' discipline, the declaration should only assert `language = typescript` once real `.ts`/`.tsx` files actually exist under `apps/studio` -- TARGET work for whenever the frontend gains real source, not this generation.
